summary: Objections identify a non-zero chance of an early Cannes Official Selection reveal (before Apr 10) driven by strategic marketing pressure and scheduling needs.
Historical timing patterns anchor announcements to mid-April, making an ultra-early release unlikely but not impossible (roughly ~15% historically).

Thus, the ensemble from 3% is adjusted upward to reflect non-zero risk while respecting established patterns.
